info.description:
Regresi end-to-end seluruh endpoint modul Orang 2: School, Headmaster, Teacher, Academic Year, Master Rombel, Teacher Class Assignment, Teacher Lifecycle, Import Guru, Dashboard Headmaster/Super Admin, Upload, Reset/Change Password. Jalankan berurutan (Collection Runner / newman) pada DATABASE BERSIH atau apa saja - data tiap run unik (suffix run_id). Lihat docs/postman/README-TEST-002.md.

REVISI Stage 6 (Okt 2026): disinkronkan dengan perilaku final Stage 1-5 + F-53 (pagination {data, meta}, F-18/F-19/F-21 Rombel dan Teacher Assignment, F-06 foto private, F-33..F-38 import sinkron, F-53 NISN vs username staf). Folder 13 dan 14 baru; daftar perubahan per request ada di TEST-002-findings.md bagian 'Sinkronisasi Stage 6'.
